info.title: Personal OS API
info.description: Local-first personal platform. Phase 10a: finance intelligence (net worth, upcoming bills, merchant aliases, budget rollover, import profiles) + planner depth (subtasks, dependencies, day-load estimates, event exceptions, habit pause, weekly review).

kind.description: liability balances subtract from net worth

balance_minor.description: opening + sum of signed transaction amounts

receipt_name.description: original file name when a receipt is attached

rate_to_base.description: multiplies stored minor units of code into base minor units

Subscription.description: Managed recurring charge; detection upserts rows, lifecycle is manual.

amount_min.description: min |amount| for the rule to fire

amount_max.description: max |amount| for the rule to fire

url.description: normalized canonical URL (lowercase host, tracking params stripped)

Item.description: Universal capture row; note/bookmark/reading rows mirror here with source_item_id set.

source_item_id.description: native record id when mirrored from a pillar table

pinned.description: pinned rows sort first in lists and search

archived.description: archived rows are hidden from lists/search unless include_archived=true

measured_at.description: one row per calendar day; same-day POST replaces

HealthSettings.description: Singleton targets row (id='default'); all fields null until set. PUT merges.

macros.description: macro totals over the window (rings numerator)
